videos.title: This is what happens when tahini meets pasta 🍋🍝
videos.description:
If you have tahini in your fridge, this is your sign to make pasta with it! 🍋🍝 🤌

Can’t tell you how many times I’ve made this pasta. Maybe cuz it’s super easy to make but still such a flavour-bomb. Maybe cuz it’s gotten the stamp of approval time and time again from the hubby and baby 🥇. 

This recipe is from my new cookbook, Simply Plants 🌱📖 (out in less than 3 weeks… eeeek!), but we’ve also shared the full recipe for free on our website as a little sneak peek 👀
